1. Put the other device on the same Wi-Fi (or on this phone's hotspot).
2. Open the address below in a browser (Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox).
3. The first time, the browser warns about the self-signed certificate: compare the fingerprint below, then continue.
4. Enter the access code, or scan the QR code with the other device.

OxygenOS may stop apps in the background. Allow Android WebCam to ignore battery optimization so the stream keeps running when the screen is off.

• Picture only: the microphone is never used, nothing is recorded or saved.
• Local network only (Wi-Fi, hotspot, USB tethering). Connections through mobile data or VPN are refused. No cloud, no account, no analytics, no ads.
• TLS 1.3 encryption, a new access code for every session, rate-limited logins, sessions bound to the viewer's IP address.
• The rear camera picture is never mirrored.
• Screenshots and screen recordings of this app are blocked.

Lets AI agents in the cloud (for example Claude Code on the web or Codex in the cloud) take a single picture when you ask them, even outside this network. While streaming, the phone then connects only to your own relay; pictures are encrypted on the phone end to end, so the relay cannot see them, and live video never goes to the cloud. Off by default.

While streaming, the phone will connect to the relay you enter (to that address only), and cloud agents can take single pictures through it. Pictures leave your local network: encrypted on the phone, passed through the relay, decrypted by the agent and given to the AI service it uses. You can turn it off or revoke agents here at any time.

Shown after streaming has been started once.

Give these instructions to this cloud agent (paste them into the chat or its standing instructions), and allow the relay\'s host in its network settings. They contain its token and decryption key: shown only this once, do not give them to anyone else.
Keep the screen on while streaming (goes black after 1 minute without touch)

Recommended. Some systems (e.g. OnePlus/OxygenOS) end background apps after the screen has been off for a while. With this on, the screen stays on but black at the lowest brightness and streaming is never ended by the system. Double-tap to return. Don\'t lock the phone with the power button while streaming. Note: the phone does not lock itself while this is on, so keep it in a trusted place.

OnePlus / OxygenOS, also recommended:
• Lock Android WebCam in Recents (open Recents, tap the app card's menu → Lock).
• Settings → Battery → Battery optimization → ⋮ → Advanced optimization: turn off Deep optimization (Adaptive battery on some versions) and Sleep standby optimization.
• Keep the phone charging when streaming for hours.
